U(1)_X feedback on the SO(10) running is neglected; the SO(10) phase is a single coupling

the GUT-scale thresholds are uncontrolled: BM-DA1 uses the committed spectrum, whose normalisation is non-perturbative (a0 ~ 21.6, g3_sm_pati_salam_witness_unitarity_v20); on the perturbative x1/50 member every scalar tree mass (the six remnants below v_R and the GUT scalars) scales by 1/sqrt50 and the root, Landau and quality numbers are not recomputed here; the GUT scalar masses x0.5 and x2 scheme variants alone move the rho = 1e3 root from v_R = 3.1e10 to 1.96e9 GeV (a factor 16; the rescue synthesis quotes up to x30)

the Planck gauge-kinetic term c Phi210 F F/M is not computed (EST only); it moves the alpha = 1 scale by more than the three-loop margins (-3.8% on the U1 root, +0.14% on the U2 root), so the three-loop verdict is convention- and threshold-limited
the RG-improved remnant masses come from anti-SOS region points: G6 is not closed and is not assumed closed
no benchmark is adopted; the windows are conditional evidence, not a G7 closure
no gate status changes; nothing is wired into the gate ledger; G7 stays BLOCKED

term_ratio_3L_over_2L_at_MPlred.definition: (b3 alpha^2/(32 pi^3))/(b2 alpha/(8 pi^2)) with b above P,Q,R, alpha on the two-loop trajectory at M_Pl,red (roots whose two-loop alpha reaches 1 below M_Pl,red have no value)

verdict: G7 is not closed on BM-DA1. It passes the reduced-Planck Landau criterion at two loops (alpha = 1 at 3.72e18 GeV on the U1 root, 3.88e18 GeV on the second-code U2 root). At three loops (gauge-only; P,Q,R at x0 p) it fails on the U1 root (2.34e18 GeV < 2.435e18 GeV, -3.8%) and passes marginally on the U2 root (2.438e18 GeV, +0.14%), so the BM-DA1 three-loop outcome lies within the two-code root uncertainty (and below the neglected two-loop GUT thresholds and Yukawa terms). With the RG-improved remnant masses (CONDITIONAL: anti-SOS region points, committed GUT scalar spectrum) the rho = 1e3 root moves to v_R = 8.56e9 GeV, <S> = 2.85e13 GeV at y_s = 0.30 and fails both axion-quality bounds; doubling the GUT scalar masses removes that failure (research scheme variant: v_R = 1.96e9 GeV, NDA 1.6e-11, Z17 4.3e-17), while U2 and the other scheme variants keep it. BM-E passes at two loops only (P,Q,R at x0 p; on both roots). Every flavour-capable SO(10)-phase addition fails the criterion at three loops at BM-DA1 (a 120_H, a second 126bar and vectorlike pairs already at two loops), as does the contract content itself on the U1 root. The SO(10)-phase running is gauge + matter only at every order and the rho windows that pass are conditional (anti-SOS remnant masses; G6 not closed; the NDA window is convention-dependent); a Planck gauge-kinetic term would move the alpha = 1 scale by more than the three-loop margins (EST). G7 stays BLOCKED.
